narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='chintu'/>I think the perimeter of the triangle is eigh plus three, because it has three sides.
<bookmark mark='s1'/>Test it with a side of two units.
<bookmark mark='s2'/>The three sides give two plus two plus two, which is six.
<bookmark mark='s3'/>But eigh plus three gives only five.
<bookmark mark='s4'/>Adding the side three times is not the same as adding three.

narration: <bookmark mark='s1'/>Check with a side of two units.

<bookmark mark='s3'/>Each formula is the number of sides times the side.
